title: Content Security Policy Directives
code:
<!-- Server sends: -->
<!-- Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'nonce-abc123'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' -->

bugs.explanation: `style-src 'unsafe-inline'` allows inline styles which can be exploited for CSS injection attacks (data exfiltration via CSS selectors). Use a nonce or hash for inline styles, or move styles to external files.

iframe sandbox Attribute
code: <iframe src="untrusted.html"></iframe>

bugs.explanation: An unsandboxed `<iframe>` can execute scripts, navigate the top-level page, access cookies, and submit forms. The `sandbox` attribute restricts these capabilities. Add only the permissions you need: `allow-scripts` for JS, `allow-forms` for forms, etc.
